name: c2d
expr: dz = c2d(sys, 0.1, 'zoh'); [bz, az] = tfdata(dz, 'v'); df = c2d(sys, 0.1, 'foh'); [bf, af] = tfdata(df, 'v'); dd = c2d(sc, 0.1, 'foh');
comment: Sig: sysd = c2d(sys, Ts[, method]). 'zoh' (default), 'foh', 'tustin'. 'foh' = first-order/triangle hold via Van Loan augmented matrix-exp [[A·Ts,B·Ts,0];[0,0,I·Ts];[0,0,0]]: Ad=Phi, Bd=G1+Phi·G2/Ts−G2/Ts, Cd=C, Dd=D+C·G2/Ts (FOH introduces a feedthrough term so the discrete tf gains a nonzero leading b). Bit-identical with MATLAB R2025b on tf(1,[1 2 1]) + an explicit ss. Queue-clearing 2026-05-29: 'foh' previously errored "method must be 'zoh' or 'tustin'". 'matched' still deferred.
